ctx.x: Did you have any particular challenges in balancing family and music?

Um … Janet probably did. I'd come home from work at night at 2 o'clock in the morning and I would stop by a restaurant and get something to eat and wake up the kids and say, Let's have something to eat. That's not a good idea at 3:30 AM, I guess. (laughs)
